beforeBaseline.purpose: Pre-tranche Notifications drawer anatomy, reconstructed from an unchanged e644 Git archive.

fixture.description: Browser-only read fixture reused from the current Notifications evidence harness. Archived UI and build assets are unchanged. Five first-page Sample notifications, seven total unread, three unread on the first page, and persisted email preferences; no command is performed.
fixture.interception: A browser init script wraps fetch assignments with closures and handles only GET notifications and notification preferences. All other requests delegate unchanged to the archived evidence runtime.

beforeBaseline.acceptance: Baseline evidence only; no visual or operational acceptance claim.

observations: The archived drawer is 560px wide at 1440px and 768px and occupies the viewport width at 390px.
Email preferences precede notifications; at 390px the first notification begins near the lower viewport edge.
No Inbox / Activity / Preferences local menu or selectable context pane exists in this baseline.
Light and dark frames show the same archived anatomy with Sample fixture data.
visualInspection.scope: Baseline structure inspection only, not design acceptance.

publication.reason: Two connected branch-creation calls returned no result before user interruption; later read-only checks found no branch or Notifications PR.

limitations: Synthetic browser fixtures verify UI contracts and request/receipt behavior, not live backend authorization, email delivery or bank outcomes.
Local Chromium153 differs from pinned CI Chromium140; full remote workflow remains pending.
Eighty axe contrast nodes remain incomplete; supplemental contrast has 148 INCOMPLETE and 38 REVIEW readings. No blanket WCAG conformance is claimed.
Mobile Inbox retains readable summaries and 44px controls; its first row is y459.5 versus source420.
Tablet Activity retains four real context facts; history starts below the first 900px viewport while context remains visible.
Whole-screen operational acceptance remains 0/19 and production cutover remains blocked.

independentVisualReview.title: Independent Notifications workspace v2 visual review

reviewer.name: GPT-6 Astra Pro
reviewer.type: AI visual and runtime reviewer; not human acceptance sign-off

independentVisualReview.summary: All 30 runtime matrix views, 12 supplemental states and 15 original source renders were directly inspected. The corrected implementation preserves the approved workspace and canonical menu anatomy. All three concrete visual defects are resolved. No remaining visual blocker was found in this scope; density and automation limitations remain explicit.

coverage.method: Opened individual PNGs through view_image and compared whole-screen anatomy and state frames. Independently matched all reviewed final images to SHA256. Six Inbox matrix images and one conflict image are byte-identical to previously inspected images; every changed runtime image was reopened.

independentVisualReview.implementationBinding: verification.json binds the committed runtime revision to production/evidence build assets, fixture modules and nine evidence-script hashes. This review does not claim later documentation commits were part of the runtime build.

resolvedFindings.issue: Activity header controls stacked and every event repeated scope plus absent Version data, reducing useful source density.
resolvedFindings.before: At 1440px, feed began around 449px and rows were around 180px high.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Compact period/refresh row; event actor, UTC time, outcome, record and event/source retained. Scope and version limitation remain in context.
resolvedFindings.after: At 1440px, feed begins at 389.5625px, first event at 495.5625px and rows are 114.1875px high. Three fixture events fit the 900px viewport. Source feed begins at 362px and first event at 475px.

resolvedFindings.issue: Stacked descriptions inherited right alignment, separating values from labels.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Inbox facts, Preferences explanations and Activity context values align with their labels; loaded and selected phone states re-inspected.

resolvedFindings.issue: Unselected Inbox context lacked internal padding.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Empty/unavailable Inbox now shows padded placeholder text; loaded segmented detail spacing is preserved.

resolvedFindings.issue: Some supplemental screenshots did not frame the named result.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final paging failure, Activity unavailable/empty and unsupported-destination captures show the actual warning, retry, empty result or disabled handoff.

observations.wholeWorkspace: Work breadcrumb, Notifications heading/wave, local tabs and view-specific regions follow source anatomy. Current selection is visible in both themes. No horizontal clipping or overlap was observed in reviewed viewports.
observations.menu: Expanded navigation at 1440/1280 and compact rails at 1024/768/390 retain canonical Home, Frameworks, Programs, Forms, Vendors, Risk & Losses, Privacy, Work & Approvals and Reports, with Work & Approvals active and Settings in the footer. Source legacy Assessments/Controls & policies/Setup variants are intentionally adapted to shared routes.
observations.inbox: Desktop list/detail proportions and persistent selected context follow the source. At 768/390, detail follows the list and selection brings it into view with Back to notifications. Phone filters begin closed behind the named disclosure. All, Unread, refresh and filters fit one toolbar. Search is explicitly limited to loaded rows; receipt and selected detail remain consistent.
observations.activity: Desktop timeline/context split follows source hierarchy. Compact events preserve actual actor/outcome/record/event-source facts. Context precedes feed at 768/390, as in source. Action success is distinguished from completion; absent record versions are disclosed once in context.
observations.preferences: Source information/email split is retained at 1440/1280/1024, with information-first stacking at 768/390. Supported digest, time zone and quiet hours replace unsupported prototype category switches. Email controls below the initial phone fold follow the source order. Conflict text remains visible with edited values.
observations.states: State frames distinguish empty, unavailable, read-command failure, pagination failure, confirmed read, selection, preference conflict, permission denial, foreign-scope rejection and unsupported navigation. Shared menu/active destination stay coherent while body content scrolls.

acceptedDifferencesAndLimits: This is a source-informed layout adaptation using actual API contracts and shared tokens, not pixel parity. Prototype sample values, unsupported controls and route variants are not fabricated in runtime.
The 15 original reference renders are light. Both runtime themes were compared against that source anatomy; no original dark-reference color parity is claimed.

Inbox uses larger, less-truncated text. At 390px its first row begins around 459px versus source 420px; full summaries and metadata produce taller rows. The first two records are visible and useful in the initial viewport.

At 768px, four actual Activity context facts wrap to a second row. Runtime first event is at 954.96875px, below the 900px initial viewport; source first event is visible. At 390px both versions put history after context; runtime first event is at 1146.65625px versus source around 952px. Context order and scrolling are coherent, but density differs.
Matrix screenshots establish the initial viewport. Named supplemental states cover selected scrolled results. This does not exhaust every scroll position, content length, device or browser.

Accessibility has 12 automated PASS scenarios, zero reported violations, undersized controls or browser errors. There remain 80 incomplete axe nodes, plus 148 INCOMPLETE and 38 REVIEW supplemental contrast readings. Visual readability does not resolve those measurements or replace a complete manual contrast audit.

Synthetic fixtures and AI review do not establish backend authorization, real-data reconciliation, production completion or human design acceptance. The separate required acceptance register remains 0/19 and is not advanced by this review.
Evidence and tests here are local. No remote CI, PR, merge, deployment or production cutover is implied.

focusedRegressionVerification.result: 13/13 passed after the compact-event data-truth assertion update.
focusedRegressionVerification.coverage: Exact scoped/period query, stale-response and permission guards, foreign-scope rejection, opaque cursor/retry, actual actor/time/outcome/record/event source, explicit context version limitation and no repeated/fabricated per-event scope/version fields.
